issue_request: FHIR-50645 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked OO to restrict Transport.for from Reference(Any) to Practitioner, Group, PractitionerRole, Organization, CareTeam, HealthcareService, Patient, Device, and RelatedPerson, plus update the short display and definition to describe the beneficiary of the transport.
initial_application: Commit 6b067f6d8d applied the requested Transport.for target-profile restriction and beneficiary wording in source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml. OO WGM minutes corroborate the narrowed list and 11-0-3 persuasive motion.
additional_context: FHIR-50911 later aligned Transport with the Event pattern by renaming Transport.for to Transport.subject and changing Transport.subject/focus to Reference(Any), while preserving FHIR-50645's beneficiary short display and definition. FHIR-51849 and FHIR-53052 continued the Event-only cleanup. Commit 3b38b80cf2 then removed Transport from active core resource configuration and current core pages now link to the OO incubator Transport artifact.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Reinstating the older Transport.for restricted target list would conflict with later applied Transport decisions and would affect only inactive residual core source, because the current active Transport artifact is outside this core build.
